mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 65 degree temperatures out by the Reddan Soccer Park under a New Moon.

The City of Verona has announced that road construction along Highway M will begin this coming Tuesday to improve underground utilities, and the Senior Center is actively looking for volunteers to support their daily programs.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market and more live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
In a notable call from last Wednesday, August 5, Verona police officers successfully took a 37-year-old man into custody on Whalen Road following a probation violation warrant.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Since the store is currently closed, please note they will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow's flavor of the day will be Turtle.
